title: instructions.create params

commandId.description: The client-generated UUID every command takes; a retry with the same id applies once.

id.description: An owned instruction's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, kept in lowercase.

catalogueId.description: The catalogue entry to copy, with no title and no body: a tick.

title.description: With body and no catalogueId: the title of one written here (Custom).

body.description: With title and no catalogueId: the body of one written here (Custom).

scope.description: The accounts it reaches; preset all.

anyOf.description: Every account on the environment, those added later included.

items.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

anyOf.description: The accounts named, each once; an account removed since reaches nothing.

enabled.description: Whether runs are handed it; preset true.

position.description: Its place in the list; preset after the last.

description: A Custom instruction's title and body, or the catalogue entry a tick copies; then its scope, whether it is enabled and its position.
